issues.issue: Did the unlawful confinement of the victim end when he escaped from the truck, thus negating first degree murder under s. 231(5)(e)?
issues.applicant_position: Unlawful confinement ended when victim escaped; no first degree murder under s. 231(5)(e).
issues.respondent_position: Victim remained unlawfully confined after escape; confinement continued until murder.
issues.result_text: Victim remained unlawfully confined after escape; confinement did not end outside truck.

issues.issue: Did the unlawful confinement and murder form a single continuous transaction justifying a first degree murder conviction under s. 231(5)(e)?
issues.applicant_position: Court of Appeal erred in concluding unlawful confinement and murder formed a single transaction.
issues.respondent_position: Unlawful confinement and murder were temporally and causally connected forming a single transaction.
issues.result_text: Unlawful confinement and murder formed one continuous transaction; acts were temporally and causally connected.
